objects.name: “Keep going, bro. You’ve got this!” A data-driven look at how adversaries are weaponizing AI
objects.description: Talos has collected prompt logs from threat actor endpoints running various applications, such as Claude Code, CodeX, Cursor, or Gemini. This blog is an analysis of the ways we've seen bad actors leveraging cloud-based AI.
